name: D-Wave Quantum Inc.
blurb: D-Wave Quantum is a Canadian-founded quantum computing company that commercialises quantum annealing — a technique suited to combinatorial optimisation problems — and, after its January 2026 acquisition of Quantum Circuits Inc. (QCI) for $550 million, also operates gate-model quantum hardware. It is one of the few publicly traded pure-play quantum computing companies.
recent: QBTS reached an all-time high of $46.75 in October 2025 partly on a sentiment surge following Nvidia's release of Ising quantum AI models, before retreating to roughly $21 by May 2026. Full-year 2025 revenue was $24.6 million (up 179% year-over-year) but the company reported losses of $355 million. D-Wave closed the year with $884.5 million in cash, providing runway despite deep unprofitability. Analyst views are sharply split: median price targets imply substantial upside while some analysts cite extreme overvaluation versus near-term fundamentals.
